# Tech & Learning

> A comprehensive resource for K-12 educators on AI integration, edtech tools, teaching strategies, and school leadership in the digital age.

Tech & Learning provides news, how-to guides, webinars, and magazine content focused on helping educators navigate technology adoption and AI in classrooms. The site features expert contributors, product coverage, and practical professional development resources for teachers and school leaders.

## Key Topics

- AI in education
- Educational technology
- AI policy and governance
- Professional development
- Classroom tools
- Teaching strategies
- EdTech products
- School leadership
- Data analytics in education
- Flipped classroom
- AI ethics
- Digital learning access
- ChatDOC
- Kira platform
- Montana Digital Academy

## AI in Education

- [AI Coverage | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/technology/ai): AI in education coverage including tools, policy, ethics, and professional development
- [What Districts Can Learn From Ohio's Mandatory AI Policy | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/technology/ai/ohio-is-the-first-state-to-mandate-school-districts-have-a-formal-ai-policy-heres-what-other-districts-can-learn-from-it): Ohio's AI policy mandate and guidance for district AI governance
- [Creating A Four-Part AI Education PD Series | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/technology/ai/from-apprehension-to-empowerment-creating-a-four-part-ai-education-pd-series): Courtney Bock's AI professional development program for educators
- [Flipped Classroom Pioneer Offers New AI Framework | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/technology/ai/flipped-classroom-pioneer-offers-new-ai-framework): Jon Bergmann's AI framework for flipped and mastery-based learning
- [Take Teaching To The Next Level: Live From The Kira Event | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/technology/ai/take-teaching-to-the-next-level-live-from-the-kira-event): Coverage of Kira AI platform event with educators and product executives

## Magazine & News

- [Tech & Learning's Latest Magazines | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/magazine/techandlearnings-latest-magazines): Magazine archive and latest issues covering K-12 edtech trends and tips
- [News | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/news): Education and technology news hub covering AI, edtech, and school leadership
- [Tech & Learning's 2026 EdTech to Watch | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/learning/edtech/tech-and-learnings-2026-edtech-to-watch): Edtech product demonstrations and 2026 predictions for K-12 learning

## How-To Guides & Tools

- [How to | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/how-to): How-to guides for AI tools, classroom technology, and teaching strategies
- [ChatDOC: Teaching With The AI Summarizing Tool | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/technology/ai/chatdoc-teaching-with-the-ai-summarizing-tool): How-to guide for ChatDOC PDF summarization and quiz generation tool
- [AI Music Generators: Teaching With These Catchy AI Tools | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/technology/ai/ai-music-generators-teaching-with-these-catchy-ai-tools): Guide to using AI music generators like Lyria 3 in music education
- [Classroom Tools Coverage | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/learning/classroom/classroom-tools): Coverage of classroom tools including Knoword, Groovelit, and Artsonia
- [Pi Day Lessons & Activities | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/news/pi-day-lessons-and-activities): Math lesson plans and STEM activities for Pi Day celebrations

## Professional Development & Webinars

- [Tech & Learning Conversations with Kevin Hogan | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/news/tech-and-learning-conversations-with-kevin-hogan): Podcast series with Kevin Hogan interviewing educators and edtech leaders

## Educational Leadership & Strategy

- [Supporting Digital Learning In Rural School Districts | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/learning/leadership/supporting-digital-learning-in-rural-school-districts): Jason Neiffer on Montana Digital Academy's rural education access solutions
- [Classroom Technology Bans: Better Learning Design Will Improve | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/learning/edtech/reverting-to-pen-and-paper-wont-improve-learning-better-learning-design-will): Analysis of classroom technology bans and effective learning design strategies
- [Mining Dark Data for Instructional Improvement | Tech & Learning](https://www.techlearning.com/technology/data/mining-dark-data-how-instructional-coaches-and-tech-facilitators-can-turn-hidden-signals-into-instructional-gains): How instructional coaches can use data analytics to improve teaching
